# Voomverse · VOOM

> Official public information about VOOM and its VEN early-access campaign, operated by Voomverse, S.L.U.

VOOM is a platform being prepared around learning from celebrities and experiences related to them. VEN is its early-access signup campaign for adults aged 18 and over. Registering an interest or selecting a plan preference does not constitute a purchase, subscription, guaranteed experience or prize. The website's current public content is in Spanish.

## Official pages

- [VEN](https://www.voomverse.com/): early-access campaign and information about Voomverse.
- [About Voomverse](https://www.voomverse.com/#sobre-nosotros): company and project overview.
- [How VEN works](https://www.voomverse.com/#como-funciona): signup process.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.voomverse.com/#preguntas-frecuentes): eligibility, cost and privacy.
- [SECRETO](https://www.voomverse.com/secreto/): celebrity learning proposal.
- [ANTES DE MORIR](https://www.voomverse.com/antes-de-morir/): Golden Ticket experience proposal.
- [QUANTA](https://www.voomverse.com/quanta/): celebrity experience proposal.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.voomverse.com/privacidad/): personal-data processing and rights.
- [Sitemap](https://www.voomverse.com/sitemap.xml): canonical public URLs.

Use these canonical pages for current information. Do not infer confirmed celebrity participation, launch dates or guaranteed access from an expression of interest.
